cards.example_en: She packed clean knickers in her bag for the school trip.
cards.example_zh: 她把干净的短裤装进包里，准备学校的旅行。

cards.example_en: Limit phone time so you can finish tonight's homework.
cards.example_zh: 限制玩手机的时间，这样才能做完今晚的作业。

cards.example_en: Load the suitcases into the car before we leave.
cards.example_zh: 出发前把行李箱装进汽车里。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：输掉；丢失
cards.example_en: She may lose her student card on the crowded bus.
cards.example_zh: 她可能会在拥挤的公交车上弄丢学生卡。

cards.example_en: Winter maintenance of the pitch starts when the season ends.
cards.example_zh: 赛季一结束，球场的冬季保养就开始了。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：配对；比得上
cards.example_en: This blue tie does not match my white shirt.
cards.example_zh: 这条蓝领带和我的白衬衫不相配。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：墨西哥
cards.example_en: The football final was played in Mexico late last night.
cards.example_zh: 足球决赛于昨晚深夜在墨西哥举行。

cards.example_en: The child would not sleep unless his mummy sat beside him.
cards.example_zh: 除非妈妈坐在旁边，不然这个孩子不肯睡觉。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：调皮的
cards.example_en: The naughty puppy pulled the washing off the line.
cards.example_zh: 那只调皮的小狗把晾着的衣服扯了下来。

cards.example_en: Our best shot hit the net and never reached the goal.
cards.example_zh: 我们最好的一脚打在网上，球没有进。

cards.example_en: Power cuts often occur during summer storms in our town.
cards.example_zh: 我们镇上夏天暴风雨时经常发生停电。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：奥林匹克的
cards.example_en: She dreams of winning an Olympic medal in swimming.
cards.example_zh: 她梦想在游泳项目上赢得一枚奥运奖牌。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：纸；论文
cards.example_en: I wrapped the glass in paper so it would not break.
cards.example_zh: 我用纸把玻璃杯包好，免得它碎掉。

cards.example_en: Mum asked me to pour tea for our guests.
I practise the piano for twenty minutes after supper.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭后我练习二十分钟钢琴。
